content.title: This stunning 144Hz 65-inch OLED TV is $400 off, at its lowest since Cyber Week
content.text: A 4K, 144Hz TV that will upscale your expectations Updated: Apr 17, 2026 1:36 pm WePC is reader-supported. When you buy through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Prices subject to change. Learn more As a hub for home entertainment, a 65-inch 4K TV is a solid option. But why not get one that is well below the list price and is ideal for gaming? Right now, you can, as we’ve spotted a Samsung TV at its most affordable since Cyber Week. The Samsung 65-Inch Class OLED S90F is a smart-looking 4K TV, and it’s capable too. The 2025 model has plenty of compelling features, and it’s currently $400 below its list price. At $1,298, you save 24% against the usual $1,698. Prices and savings subject to change. Samsung 65-Inch Class OLED S90F 4K Smart TV (2025 Model) NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor, 4K AI Upscaling Pro, OLED HDR +, Motion Xcelerator 144Hz, Samsung Vision AI, Alexa Built-in Why we like the 65-Inch Class OLED S90F Stunning viewing Users’ reviews are united: the 65-inch Class OLED S90F is a beautiful watch. This 4K OLED can achieve deep blacks and vibrant colors. Its NQ4 AI Gen3 processor delivers impressive brightness and optimizes each scene for the best viewing. Superb upscaling The S90F can call on 128 neural networks to deliver AI-enhanced picture and sound. This enables upscaling of everything you watch to 4K. Additionally, the TV can intelligently transform SDR content into HDR-like quality. So, you’ll always get a boosted viewing experience. Great for gaming The S90F is a native 144Hz 4K TV with a Game Mode, so it’s a good pick if you or your family members are console gamers looking for a TV to double up as a console display. This TV has 4x HDMI ports (and eARC too), so you can add multiple devices for easier switching while gaming. What to consider before you buy This is the lowest price the Samsung 65-Inch Class OLED S90F has seen outside of last year’s Cyber Week sale. And it offers a lot of quality and features. At the deal price, it’s a fine option if you’re after a premium TV with upscaling capabilities. However, it’s sensible to compare prices and ensure it has all the features you need.
